For SARS-CoV-2 RNA detection, 5 μl of RNA template was tested as previously described, using the US CDC real-time RT-qPCR primer/probe sets for 2019-nCoV_N1, 2019-nCoV_N2, and the human RNase P (RP) as an extraction control.
